payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear demonstration that RNNs with arbitrary precision can be shown to be as powerful as pushdown automata (PDAs).

claims.text: RNNs with one hidden layer and ReLU activation, when allowed arbitrary precision, are at least as computationally powerful as pushdown automata.
Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) can also be shown to be at least as powerful as pushdown automata when infinite precision is allowed.
The results indicate that simple RNNs with arbitrary precision are computationally equivalent to PDAs.
